value.title: dd-native builder — the structural proof graph, wired end to end
value.summary: Make the builder pipeline dd-native, 100%: plans and per-phase task files are authored as .dd.json (humans read the generated sibling — there is no -plan.md), the flight-plan template and expander author the dd_link gates, and navigation is mechanically refused when the documents say the work is not done. Around that spine: typed link relations (a frozen five with machine semantics), the per-item links bucket, mandatory pressure on every assertion, the satisfies edge from tasks to the ACs they serve, a semantic validation layer (harness plan validate) with contradiction warnings, scoped proof-tree reads, and a strict-zero --complete mode, plus a PR surface that renders closed ACs with their resolved evidence for the human checkpoint. The thesis: the graph does not make claims true — it makes false claims expensive and visible. Agents run the journey autonomously; humans review claims-with-evidence at the PR.

sections.name: research_context
sections.value: Direct continuation of plan 065 (shipped, PR #87): the dd document layer, builder/* schemas, exemplar corpus, and flow-spine departure gate all exist and are tested — but nothing drives them (zero dd_links in any flight plan; builder has no dd knowledge). Design authority: the 2026-08-04 Jordan/koala session, recorded as a RULED/LEAN/OPEN ledger in docs/plans/065-deterministic-documents/builder-tuning/notes.md and the design doc structural-proof-graph.md beside it. An independent Opus validation pass (NEEDS ATTENTION, 10 findings F1–F10) was folded in — all ten addressed, the load-bearing ones promoted to Key Findings. Plan #90 (merged) moved builder in-repo (skills/builder/), introduced the assets/ layout, the 7b post-flight stage, and plan archiving — constraints this plan lands inside. This plan is itself the first dd-native plan: this document IS the dogfood, and authoring it forced the schema extension it rides on (full builder spec as schema sections) plus one recorded difficulty (the CLI-frozen id-prefix registry).

sections.name: goals
value: Typed link relations: semantics on the rel, not the field name; five built-ins frozen (pressure, proven_by, satisfies, derives, ref); unknown rels legal, treated as ref.
Every list item can carry a links bucket (list-typed rel ref), auto-rendered as a final table column when present, traversed by dd graph map.

Every done_when assertion names its instrument: pressure is a BP-row link or the literal not-applicable; absence is a validation ERROR. BP rows are a toolbelt — no state, no coverage reading, they gate nothing.
evidence sections become done_when (the dw- prefix already says so).
Task rows carry satisfies (always an array) back to the ACs they serve.

harness plan validate grows the semantic layer: open-completables summary (info), rel-generic contradiction warnings (always), --address scoping (the proof-subgraph read), and --complete mode (per-row opens + orphan ACs + strict-zero green).

The flow gains a check-kind gate: the last review node refuses departure until plan validate --complete is green; phase nodes gate on their task sections; the builder template/expander authors all of it.
1b plan and 5 tasks author .dd.json natively — the plan document is plan.dd.json with its generated sibling, no -plan.md exists; ship renders the dd-derived AC/evidence table into the PR body.
The dd command surface is taught positionally: baked into node instructions[] and each stage module at its seam.

Self-hosting: by ship, plan 070's OWN corpus is fully retrofitted — real gates hit during the journey, real validations, backpressure and log linked — indistinguishable from a plan authored entirely by the finished feature.

The flow evaluates its own delivery: the flow-eval harness extension (and its prompting) gains a single-phase dd-native scenario — a blind subject runs the new builder flow end-to-end and telemetry-scored assertions prove it used the tooling correctly.

sections.name: non_goals
value: No probe execution anywhere in dd/plan surfaces (ruled, twice): harness checks owns instrument execution; validate reads the record.
No AC-state derivation — closure stays a performed act (agents close; the guard rails make it trustworthy).
No code-drift freshness beyond the existing basis ledger (ruled: solve when it bites).
No migration of existing markdown plans (058–069 stay as they are; the archive is institutional memory, not a conversion backlog).
No per-assertion satisfies (ruled: task row, coarse).
No allowlist/policy surface for --complete warnings (ruled: strict zero; --force is the bypass).
No changes to the five lifecycle hooks, the harness-seam doctrine, or the E44x gate codes' meanings.
No multi-phase flow-eval scenario in this plan — single-phase first; multi-phase considered later.

value.approach: Hybrid — TDD for the new dd-core logic (rel parsing, contradiction engine, --complete/--address predicates, check-gate evaluator); lightweight validation for renderer columns, skill prompt-ware, and PR body assembly.
value.rationale: The correctness heart feeds gates other systems trust; wiring follows exercised patterns.
value.focus_areas: Control discipline (house rule: a check only ever run against good input has been demonstrated, not tested): every new warning/error class gets a planted-bad fixture proving it FIRES, plus a good twin; the pre-JIT target-invalid refusal pinned as intended behaviour; legacy markdown read path pinned over a legacy-folder fixture. Synthetic-corpus discipline: a shared fixture factory builds mock plans/phases/task files, and lifecycle-mutation suites drive them through the journey's state transitions (tick, untick, block, human-skip, JIT-birth of task files, basis drift) asserting validator and gate behaviour at every step — unit-level proof across the mutation space, not just point fixtures.
value.excluded: Pixel-level markdown cosmetics beyond structural goldens; probe execution (out of scope by ruling).
value.mock_usage: Fake ports only (injected fake-fs/clock; no vi.mock); real fixture corpora extending the exemplar. Prompt-ware behaviour proven by the scripted end-to-end dry-run (create → JIT → refuse → green → depart) at the P3+P4 join, with the CLI as the actor.

value.location: docs/how/dd/ chapters extended in place (relations, done_when, satisfies, links bucket, --complete/--address); structural-proof-graph.md promotes from builder-tuning/ into docs/how/dd/ once schemas land; baked dd docs regenerated via gen:dd-docs wherever the schema surface changes.
value.rationale: Agents discover dd through the CLI (dd docs, orient instructions[], refusal next_actions); humans get the deep reference in docs/how/dd/. ac-7016 makes the builder flow itself teach the commands positionally.

value.claim: Relations: a schema may declare rel on any link field (single or array items); the five built-in rels parse, resolve, and are exposed on the resolved schema; an unknown rel string is accepted and behaves as ref; dd graph map labels edges with their rel and can filter by it; the built-in set is frozen in the surface manifest (docs/plans/065-deterministic-documents/tasks/phase-1-dd-core-foundations/dd-surface.md, one-line renegotiation to extend); AND every existing builder/* link field declares its rel (pressure→pressure, proven_by→proven_by, done→derives, satisfies→satisfies), pinned by a schema test, so the engine is live on real plans from day one.

Links bucket: any list-item shape may carry a links bucket (array of rel-ref links) without per-schema bespoke fields; rendered as a final Links column only when at least one item in that list has entries; edges appear in dd links / dd graph map; absent bucket renders byte-identical to today.

Pressure mandatory: in the builder/done_when schema, an assertion without pressure is a validation ERROR (planted-bad fixture proves it fires); pressure not-applicable validates, renders honestly, and is queryable (a stock jq one-liner lists every not-applicable assertion — documented).

done_when rename: builder schemas and the exemplar use done_when (unchanged dw- ids); renderer titles read naturally; no evidence-named section remains in living builder schemas; frozen historical corpora are signposted, not rewritten.
satisfies: task rows carry satisfies as an always-array of rel-typed links to AC rows; dd graph map on an AC shows the incoming work-accounting; a non-array satisfies fails validation.

Contradiction engine: harness plan validate warns whenever a gate-terminal item links (via proven_by, satisfies, or derives) to a checkable target that is not gate-terminal — written once against rels, never field names; planted-bad fixtures prove each rel path fires; consistent-open and evidence-ready-unclaimed stay silent.

--complete mode: adds per-row warnings for every open completable and every orphan AC (no incoming satisfies); green means zero errors and zero warnings; without --complete, opens appear only as a summary info line; envelope semantics follow house degrade rules.

Scoped validate: --address <address> scopes the semantic checks to the address's reachable closure (outbound + incoming satisfies for AC rows), reusing the P7 graph-map traversal; scoped runs are always per-row (strict implied); green = in-scope terminal + no contradictions + no stale bases in scope; the phase gate itself stays on the cheap completion read.

Check-kind gate: a flow node may carry dd_link {check: plan-validate, address}; departure evaluates the semantic validator live, refuses on non-green quoting the findings verbatim, records --force as a defended override exactly as the completion gate does; the completion-kind gate is unchanged; both kinds share the untrusted-reading discipline.

Template authors the gates: the template + expander emit dd_links — each phase node gating on assets/tasks/phase-N/tasks.dd.json#tasks (bare ordinal — a stated dd-native amendment to #90's phase-N-<kebab-title> convention: a static template can bake an ordinal address before titles exist, and retitling a phase must never move its task-file address), the last review node carrying the check gate; a pre-JIT departure refuses target-invalid, pinned by test.

dd-native authoring: 1b plan emits plan.dd.json (+ built sibling plan.dd.md) as THE plan document — no -plan.md exists in a dd-native plan folder — and 5 tasks emits assets/tasks/phase-N/tasks.dd.json with done_when lists and satisfies edges, adding the phase row's tasks link in the same stroke; the flow discovers both; the scripted end-to-end dry-run (create → JIT → refuse → green → depart) runs as the wiring phase’s exit (ph-7002).

PR surface: ship renders the dd-derived AC table into the PR body — state marks + resolved proven_by / pressure / incoming-satisfies as clickable references — generated from the corpus under docs/plans/archive/<ord>-<slug>/ (7b has already archived; the #90 read-from-archive rule); refuses to fabricate on an unclosed corpus.

Layout & archive: the dd-native plan root holds plan.dd.json, plan.dd.md, the-flow.json, the-flow.md, plus original-ask.md where one exists (the stated amendment to #90's allow-list: the dd pair REPLACES <slug>-plan.md); task files under assets/tasks/phase-N/; after the post-flight git mv the corpus is doctor-clean AND the archive step rewrites the flow's repo-root-anchored dd_link addresses (fromPath null — they would otherwise silently go stale).

Exemplar & docs: the exemplar upgrades to the new schemas — 18 of 26 dw- rows currently lack pressure and each gets a real link or not-applicable; the exemplar keeps its teaching layout at docs/how/dd/exemplar/ (a corpus, not a plan folder — NOT re-homed); docs/how/dd/ + baked docs cover the new surface; just checks green; warn trio at baseline.

Legacy read path retained: dd-native is the only write path; the legacy markdown read/adopt/resume path stays unchanged — every in-flight markdown plan still detects, adopts, and resumes; pinned by a detection test over a legacy-folder fixture.

Tooling taught where it's needed: the dd/plan command surface is documented at BOTH builder layers — (a) node instructions[] baked by template/expander so harness flow orient (re-read every turn) surfaces the right command positionally (phase nodes: scoped rehearsal + state updates; last review: --complete, closure, verify-basis; gates print their own --force etiquette on refusal); (b) stage modules teach their seam's commands (5 tasks: authoring; 6/6a: state flips + rehearsal; 7: closure + --complete; 8: PR render). A dry-run reader following only orient output + the current stage module never lacks a command this plan introduced.

Self-hosting: by the final review, plan 070's own corpus is fully dogfooded — backpressure.dd.json and execution-log.dd.json exist with AC rows carrying pressure/proven_by links; per-phase task files exist with done_when lists (mandatory pressure honoured); tasks carry rel-typed satisfies; the flight plan carries real dd_link gates exercised by the actual journey with the evidence RECORDED where each side lives: at least one genuine refusal captured in telemetry (command_exit carrying the gate E-code — refusals write nothing to the flow by pinned invariant) and any force as the existing dd-gate-override flow event; plan validate --complete runs green at the last review node's gate; ship's PR renders this plan's own AC table. The corpus is indistinguishable from one authored entirely by the finished feature — the plan is its own acceptance fixture.

Flow-eval conformance: the flow-eval extension carries a single-phase dd-native builder scenario — a BLIND subject peer (pij) runs the new flow end-to-end on a scaffolded repo, and telemetry-scored assertions prove correct tool use: plan authored as plan.dd.json with no -plan.md, task file JIT-born with done_when + mandatory pressure + satisfies, at least one gate refusal evidenced in telemetry (command_exit gate E-code — tk-7069) followed by a pass, plan validate --complete green before ship-ward departure, states mutated through dd surfaces (never hand-edited generated md). Scenario prompting/instructions updated to match; scored via harness flow-eval score and ledgered. Multi-phase deferred.

sections.name: risks_assumptions
sections.value: Standing assumption: R-elegance — when a mechanism can be a convention, it is. The dd/flow injection seams shipped in 065 accommodate the second gate kind without surface renegotiation beyond the E45x block. The #90 layout amendments (dd pair replaces -plan.md at root; bare-ordinal task dirs) are accepted as STATED amendments in the builder docs, never silent divergence. Risk detail: see the risks section.

value.question: ac-7007 non---complete posture (open completables as one summary info line, per-row warnings only under --complete) is a carried LEAN — koala's warning-fatigue proposal, narratively walked with Jordan but not explicitly confirmed. One-line confirm or veto flips the wording; nothing else depends on it.

value.why: The 2026-08-04 design session (one question at a time, narrative scenarios) played the workshop role; its rulings are the ledger in 065/builder-tuning/notes.md.

value.question: Who closes ACs?
value.answer: Agents — fully autonomous journeys; humans review ACs + linked evidence at the PR stage.

value.question: BP coverage predicate — any incoming link, or only settled assertions?
value.answer: Neither — BP is a toolbelt; the obligation flips to assertions (mandatory pressure), and the toolbelt gates nothing.

value.question: Escape for assertions no instrument checks?
value.answer: pressure: not-applicable — explicit and queryable; silence fails.

value.question: Rel vocabulary governance?
value.answer: Frozen core of five + open namespace (unknown rels behave as ref).

value.question: --complete green semantics?
value.answer: Strict zero warnings; bypass via defended --force (human-authorized, recorded).

value.question: Builder authoring format?
value.answer: Fully dd-native, no dual write path; in future there will not be a -plan.md, just dd. Rebase first (#90 landed in main).

value.question: Probe linking (ACs run probes, go green)?
value.answer: Keep away from it — harness checks fills that role for now; later iteration maybe, not now.

sections.name: implementation_summary
sections.value: The dd proof graph shipped in 065 but nothing drives it: no flight plan carries a dd_link, builder authors markdown, and the semantic questions (does this plan's story hang together?) have no surface. This plan wires the loop end to end — schema features first (rels, buckets, mandatory pressure, satisfies), then the semantic validator, then the flow wiring (gates + dd-native authoring, exiting on the end-to-end dry-run), then one close-out phase: PR surface, corpus/docs upgrade, self-hosting audit, and the blind flow-eval. The outcome: an autonomous journey whose phase departures are mechanically refused until the documents prove the work, and whose PR hands the human reviewer claims with their evidence one click away.

value.finding: 18 of 26 exemplar dw- rows lack pressure — the mandatory rule breaks the corpus as-is.

value.finding: Dogfood (this document): the dd id-prefix registry is a CLI constant (ID_PREFIXES in core/constants.ts) — a schema cannot mint new item kinds, so full-spec sections (key findings, gate rows, open questions) were designed without id fields; and the builder/plan schema had to be extended with 15 new sections to carry the full builder spec.
value.action: ph-7001 revisits (same phase): either register prefixes in schema declarations or bless id-less rows as the pattern for non-addressable sections; the schema extension ships as part of this plan.

value.finding: Gate refusals are currently unprovable from evidence — a triple loss: the refusal writes nothing to the flow (pinned P6 invariant, flow-mutations.ts:126-127), outcome-events never reads envelope.error.code, and flow failures collapse to verb 'flow'. Only a FORCE is durable (dd-gate-override flow event). ac-7017/ac-7018 depend on refusal evidence existing.
value.action: tk-7069: capture envelope.error.code in command_exit (fixed-vocab, privacy-precedented by checks.gates/mark.verdict) — refusal lands in telemetry, the nothing-written flow invariant survives untouched.

value.finding: SessionEvidence deliberately excludes command_exit, file, artifact, and mark events (session-evidence.ts:311-333), and the flow-eval resolvers mirror must stay lock-step (a CLI test asserts it). Any new assertion keying on those needs the single seam widened on both sides.
value.action: tk-7069 widens SessionEvidence + resolvers lock-step; everything else in the dd scenario reuses existing assertion types (harness-verb-ran takes full two-token verbs like 'dd validate'; file-created/forbidden-state/file-content-matches/command-succeeds cover the fs lane — planted-friction A6-A9 is the exact precedent).
